memberdef.argsstring: (lv_obj_t *obj, lv_grid_align_t column_align, uint8_t col_pos, uint8_t col_span, lv_grid_align_t row_align, uint8_t row_pos, uint8_t row_span)
memberdef.name: lv_obj_set_grid_cell

detaileddescription.para:
Set the cell of an object. The object's parent needs to have grid layout, else nothing will happen
obj
pointer to an object
column_align
the vertical alignment in the cell. LV_GRID_START/END/CENTER/STRETCH
col_pos
column ID
col_span
number of columns to take (>= 1)
row_align
the horizontal alignment in the cell. LV_GRID_START/END/CENTER/STRETCH
row_pos
row ID
row_span
number of rows to take (>= 1)
Just a wrapper to LV_GRID_FR for bindings.
